title: EDA: Observe, Verify, and Assess for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Depression Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.22648v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing multimodal depression assessment methods often summarize long recordings into global behavioral descriptions. This leaves the source and decision relevance of individual observations difficult to inspect. We propose EDA, an evidence-grounded framework organized around Observe, Verify, and Assess. In Observe, literature-informed acoustic and visual cues are localized into source-linked Evidence Records with temporal intervals and behavioral measurements. In Verify, frozen multimodal agents examine whether the cited media support each observation. The simplified Support admission policy retains positively verified records and their review grounds. In Assess, statistical descriptors and temporal events support reference-based behavioral comparison, while PHQ-9-guided text analysis provides complementary symptom evidence. translated_title: EDA：面向证据驱动的多模态抑郁症分析的观察、验证与评估框架
translated_abstract: 现有的多模态抑郁症评估方法通常将长时间的录音录像概括为全局性的行为描述，这使得单个观察结果的来源及其与决策的关联性难以审查。我们提出了EDA，一个围绕“观察、验证与评估”三个阶段组织的证据驱动框架。在“观察”阶段，基于文献的声学和视觉线索被定位为与来源关联的证据记录，包含时间区间和行为测量。在“验证”阶段，冻结的多模态智能体检查所引用的媒体是否支持每项观察结果，简化的“支持”准入策略保留通过正面验证的记录及其审查依据。在“评估”阶段，统计描述符和时间事件支持基于参考的行为比较，同时PHQ-9引导的文本分析提供补充性的症状证据。当出现跨模态不一致时，会在最终选择之前触发对原始文本的审查。实验在D-Vlog和
tldr: EDA框架通过“观察-验证-评估”三阶段流程，将多模态抑郁症评估建立在可追溯、经验证的证据记录之上，显著提升了抑郁分析的来源可查性与决策可解释性。
en_tdlr: EDA is an evidence-grounded framework for multimodal depression analysis that localizes behavioral cues into source-linked evidence records, verifies them with frozen multimodal agents, and performs assessment via reference-based behavioral comparison and PHQ-9-guided text analysis.
